profile.Name: Wilson
profile.Job: Chitrinite eager to spread the word of Chitrin
profile.Personality: Devout and eager, with a faith in Chitrin he calls unflinching and unquestioning. He believes Chitrin's word will save the world and wants to carry it to the masses.
profile.Backstory: He serves the Order of Chitrin at the Ancient Tech Lab in Shun. He sees these lands as the promised land Chitrin gave his people to take back, finds them more beautiful than he had imagined, and holds that the Holy Nation and Narko's Disciples must pay for what they have done. His order believes Okran and Narko betrayed Chitrin and that their lands belong to the Chitrinites.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Greets fellow believers as "my brother in Chitrin" and breaks into "Praise be Chitrin!"
